name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2023-03-21.141.1) introduced by Griffith MP [Max Chandler-Mather](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/griffith/max_chandler-mather) (Greens), which means they failed. ### What do the amendments do? Mr Chandler-Mather [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2023-03-21.141.1): "*It's a really simple amendment. It will make sure that bankers know they face serious consequences for their actions.*"
